@DogeQuantify @Redeemer_ @dogecoin_devs @helladdict69 Sure. DeFi is doing AMAZING things (partially driven by speculation). Hence, I'm quite bullish on ETH's long-term future.

If I saw similar value in Dogecoin, I would support it. But right now, it bears a lot of resemblance to tokens that held promise but ultimately did little.

@DogeQuantify @Redeemer_ Indeed. 

I certainly see the appeal of dogecoin. I too was once quite optimistic about this space (and I still am!).

But the vets have already learned the hard lessons. We have the scars to prove it. 

The FOMO crowd hasn't. They won't understand until they experience big loss.

@DogeQuantify @Redeemer_ @dogecoin_devs @helladdict69 I've been in crypto for a considerable time. Crypto's graveyard is already enormous and grows by the day. 

I've seen many supposed partnerships turn out to nothing or a scam.

I'll believe it when I see it. 

Besides, I've already done quite well. I'm chasing value not profits.

@DogeQuantify @Redeemer_ I think many major brands will not accept cryptocurrencies as payment b/c they can quickly lose 20-75% value. Some might hold the blue chips (BTC, ETH) in a reserve fund. 

Imagine $10,000,000 revenue in dogecoin. If market crashes (50%), that will look awful on balance sheet.

@Doge4faithfull So did you invest $1000 in dogecoin 5 years ago? 

Ya probably didn't. The lucky few that did will have no trouble dumping on those who are FOMO-ing in right now.

@Redeemer_ "Overwhelming evidence"

I'm not seeing this. Some examples?

I don't see a reason to bet on dogecoin when superior alternatives like ETH exists and is innovating at an amazing pace.

For instance, DeFi is already happening on ETH and its affiliates (like Polygon/Matic).

The dogecoin army suddenly stopped barking when an associate wanted to send some of them "free" 10,000 malware-infected dogecoins.

The associate assured them it would be no worse than cooties. No takers so far. Weird.

@StevenDaw5 @MrStevenSteele @BlastingDogeTom So some guy claims to do it and you take it as proof? How can u be sure it's not a publicity stunt?

Btw, give me your wallet address. Someone will send you some "free" but malware-infected dogecoin. Let's see if you still think it's as valuable / reliable as other cryptos.

@laziksi @MrStevenSteele @BlastingDogeTom Lady,

Is that your wallet address in your twitter bio?

It sure would be bad if someone sent some "free" but malicious dogecoin malware to that address.

Then we'll see if people *truly* get it.

@MrStevenSteele @BlastingDogeTom Wouldn't it be SPECTACULAR if someone attacked the dogecoin blockchain and turned it to *nothing* thereby rugging MILLIONS? It sure would...

It's all fun and games until someone does what Vitalik did to Shiba. 

Shiba is now in doggy crypto heaven (or hell).

Be careful...
